facts.value: Calls HSD_Rand exactly once, even for max_val zero. For nonnegative max_val and a representable signed product, scales the returned 0..65535 sample with integer division by 65536. max_val up to 32768 guarantees that product fits s32 for every sample; larger values can overflow signed multiplication. No validation, clamp, retry or rejection sampling occurs.
